data.content_ref: inline:The §11.3 flag is sustained by design: the adjudication ritual is a *stabilizing negative-feedback loop* that prevents premature closure. The ritual deliberately withholds a clean audit until the critic ecosystem reaches equilibrium—both critics converging on the same verdict for the same claim. The failures in SRC_007 and SRC_009 are not anomalies but the expected oscillation of a control system that has not yet settled. The covering principle is *homeostatic adjudication*: the flag is the error signal driving the system toward critic convergence, and its persistence indicates the system is correctly resisting premature lock-in.
